description: Link pairs of library items as "Related", the link Zotero shows in an item's Related pane, on BOTH items of each pair, as Zotero itself does. Additive only: every relation an item already has (other Related links, merge records, any other predicate) is kept, and a pair already linked is reported as such and not written again. Both items must be in the same library. Every item is read before anything is written, so an unknown key refuses the whole call. Get candidates from zotero_suggest_related (pairs that cite each other), or pass any pairs you choose. To remove a link, edit `relations` with zotero_update_item. Writes go to the running Zotero desktop app (Zotero 10+) for every library it holds, otherwise to the cloud Web API. A personal library that has never synced to a zotero.org account cannot be linked from here: Zotero names it in the link by a local id neither API exposes.

library_id.description: Numeric id of the library to address, e.g. 5234875 for a group (zotero_groups lists the ids you can reach). Omit to use the configured default library; an id given without library_type is read as a group id.

library_type.description: Which library to address: "user" (a personal library) or "group" (a shared group library). Omit to use the library this server is configured for. "group" on its own is refused: pass library_id with it.

pairs.description: Pairs to link, at most 100. Order inside a pair does not matter; both items get the link.

related_key.description: The item to link it to.

name: zotero_relate_items

added.description: Keys newly linked from this item.

alreadyLinked.description: Keys this item already named as Related.

error.description: Why this item failed. Its partners may still have been linked to it.

newVersion.description: The item's version after the write.

target.description: Where the write went: "local" (Zotero desktop local API), "desktop" (connector protocol) or "cloud" (Zotero Web API).

title: Link items as Related
